title: Audit of data, complexity counting and aggregation (no training)
question: Can the numbers of E010-E021 be trusted (data leakage, raw BER, RM counting, tuning budget, noise floor, aggregator)?
git_commit: recorded per run in results/runs/*.json (field git_commit); rule commit: see LOG.md
eval_rule: validation and (report-only) test every max(500, steps/40) steps; selection only by validation
metadata_note: the CSV files have 4 columns (tx_I, tx_Q, rx_I, rx_Q) and no metadata on launch power, OSNR or channel; file names carry only the PR id (E023 config)

leakage.rule_text: no leakage if, for K = 12, the share of test windows whose exact label sequence occurs in train is <= 5 x the random share 1 - exp(-N_train_windows / 16^K) and < 1 %

dedup_retrain.name: dedup_v4_w31_h119
dedup_retrain.note: only if leakage: 1 seed, recipe F3 (fallback before E025)

rule_draft.status: DRAFT: to be confirmed by the user before the first run; must not change after results are seen
rule_draft.leakage: no leakage if for K = 12 the share of matched test->train windows <= 5 x random and < 1 %; otherwise results/gate_status.json halt: true (queue stops), dedup test + v4 h119 1 seed 60k
rule_draft.raw_ber: recomputed raw test BER (window-31 centres) must equal 0.009551859551859552 (E004-E023)
rule_draft.rm: every stored macs_per_symbol(_merged) of E010-E023 must equal the independent formula; mismatches listed
rule_draft.noise_floor: minimal detectable difference with 5 seeds = t_{0.975,8} s_pooled sqrt(2/5) (E019 configurations)
rule_draft.aggregator: a point = one configuration with >= 3 seeds; family from results/family_map.csv; level window +-25 % on a log scale; best by validation
